RATES_BPS.rationale: Session real-rate repricing bands are conservative fixed engineering priors, not outcome-optimized thresholds.

POLICY_BPS.rationale: Near-curve policy repricing bands distinguish small noise from material meeting-path shifts without fitting to Gold outcomes.

USD_INDEX_POINTS.rationale: Diagnostic DXY/index-point movement bands; never used as direct causal-root magnitude unless the root contract explicitly owns it.

GENERIC_Z.rationale: Used only for family-specific history-normalized values with point-in-time-safe history.
